cohort: The study included 1015 Polish women who completed an electronic questionnaire.
finding: A maternal plant-based diet practiced 6 months before and during pregnancy did not significantly change the incidence of GDM, anemia, gestational hypertension, delivery method, or newborn birth weight compared to an omnivore diet.
mod_finding: No association was found between diet type before conception and a delivery method.
cross-section timing: Data was collected regarding diet and physical activity 6 months before pregnancy and during pregnancy.
